migration_safety_contract_recommendation.classification: Proposed acceptance semantics, distinguish these additions from original behavior in module record.
migration_safety_contract_recommendation.data_root: Only explicit anonymous data root, retain compatible key printer/name and UTF-8 INI semantics; never reuse reference pcConfigPath or OS printer defaults. Prefer own module configuration file/root to avoid unsynchronized separate writers of hospital/account settings.
migration_safety_contract_recommendation.load: Load committed name or empty for new anonymous file; preserve and visibly display an unavailable persisted name. Empty list means no enumerated devices; never fabricate devices or silently select first/OS default.
migration_safety_contract_recommendation.select: Selection only changes draft; preserve exact opaque Unicode device names, not Windows-specific aliases. Use deterministic anonymous injected printer-name list for no-hardware tests while actual enumeration is separate.
migration_safety_contract_recommendation.apply: No-op unchanged without write. Changed empty rejects. Changed selected name requires actual serialization/sync and atomic checked replacement before committed snapshot/success; preserve unrelated keys. A newly selected device disappearing during operation needs an explicit unavailable result with old committed name retained; no automatic fallback/test print.
migration_safety_contract_recommendation.unavailable: A saved device not currently enumerated remains saved/displayed with unavailable status; no automatic clearing. Missing spooler/device discovery cannot be called physical-print success. Original has no enumeration-error branch, so any richer diagnostic must state its available evidence.
migration_safety_contract_recommendation.failure_recovery: Read/parse/permission/disk/write/commit failure must preserve prior bytes and committed snapshot, keep draft for retry, show true error and re-enable controls. Close/navigation while write busy waits/rejects through existing guards; report success only after real completion.
migration_safety_contract_recommendation.draft_guard: Use existing requestLeave/action pipeline for subpage/main-page switch, logout and close. Continue-editing cancels navigation without write; explicit discard restores last committed snapshot without write. Do not add/reflow a new Cancel business button; state original had none. Keep stored committed value on session changes and do not treat role number as new ACL.
migration_safety_contract_recommendation.lifecycle: Enumeration/persistence latency must be observed and kept off GUI event-loop blocking paths where necessary; object worker/thread/timer lifetime and normal exit require evidence. Do not spawn recurring poll timers just for a local settings page.
migration_safety_contract_recommendation.linux: Use Qt5 PrintSupport existing build dependency and platform discovery; allow zero available printers, missing driver/spooler and stale configured name. No automatic CUPS install/service/OS-default modification, no printer job or reference configuration use.

save/parse/read-only/atomic-commit failure preserves old bytes/committed state and allows retry with draft intact
leave continue/discard, logout and shutdown guards cover draft/busy and worker completion; Guest/other original roles are checked without fabricated ACL
unified path6->3 has actual new page and retained geometry/QSS; report preview/PDF cumulative regression still leaves physical print disabled
platform builds, actual original Windows visual/runtime behavior, Linux target printer discovery and RK screen/input/resource/physical printer validation remain distinct
